g.text: Half of all sailings arrive late.
And when a box is late, most of the cost lands on the forwarder.
ONE TRIP, SIX PLACES IT GOES WRONG, AND WHO PAYS
bumped to a later ship: +7 days
WHAT THE FORWARDER KEEPS ON ONE BOX
€127 when all goes well, then €115 for every day it waits.
storage, re-booking, customs paperwork, chasing: 4 of the 6
a day while the box waits
when it is bumped to the next ship
swing in the price of one container
of the world’s ship capacity lost
It is not an edge case. It is the whole job.
One bottleneck, five days of waiting, and the forwarder loses 3.5× what the box earns.
€448 lost against €127 earned, from the chart above
Automates the desk. Acts before the route breaks.
